Decision to make
You support an internal knowledge desk. Calculate net minutes saved at two thresholds and identify omitted costs.

Core concept
Include review time, retries, maintenance and setup as well as generation. Estimate ranges. Time saved does not automatically equal cash saved.

Practice contract
Compare 8 baseline minutes per record with 2 assisted minutes plus 7 review minutes for missing/low confidence, or 1 minute otherwise.

Evidence and boundary
Show normal, missing and uncertain cases. No real data or external actions.

Review and reflect
